## Question and hypothesis
What do you expect to change, and why?

## Baseline and independent change
Name the config/arm and the single change. Identify changed parameter or compute budgets.

## Smallest useful experiment
Commands or proposed flag, data/evaluation split, steps, paired seeds and hardware.

## Success and failure criteria
What outcome would support the idea? What would disprove it? How will unsuccessful runs be reported?

## Educational explanation
Which model concepts or notebook lessons would help someone understand the idea?
